title: Normalize Druid armor proficiency; lift metal restriction to proficiencyNotes
description: Deficiency #5. Exported class record folds the Druid metal restriction into the armorProficiencies token: 'shields (druids will not wear armor or use shields made of metal)'. Schema already anticipates proficiencyNotes for exactly this. Fix: normalize Druid armorProficiencies to ["Light armor","medium armor","shields"] and emit a separate proficiencyNotes entry with the metal restriction. Generalize to any similar parenthetical mechanical note folded into a proficiency token. Re-freeze gate: no mixed mechanical note tokens in proficiency arrays.
notes: STALE-SNAPSHOT FINDING (from o9bd.11 verification 2026-06-28): the committed pack ALREADY has clean armorProficiencies:[Light armor, medium armor, shields] + a proficiencyNotes:[{field,text}] array for Druid. The metal restriction is already lifted. This bead may be largely/fully DONE — re-verify the committed pack before implementing. The o9bd.11 proficiency-note-bleed gate ships GREEN as a regression guard for this.
